analysis.title: Marketcolour + Webcast on Midterms / Europe Strategy / Bayer / Zalando / Gecina (dg) / Heidelberg
key_insights: US equities closed mostly higher on Tuesday: SPX +36 bps to 7,568, NDX +68 bps to 28,180 (Semis up about 2.5%), RTY +23 bps to 2,812. Tech was +131 bps, Materials -193 bps, Staples -176 bps.

The Data Centers basket (GSTMTDAT +3.70%) and the AI Basket (GSTMTAIP +2.78%) outperformed. In Europe, EU Miners (GSXEMINE -2.8%) underperformed with copper at an 11-week low, and EU Big Oils (GSXEBOIE -1.2%) sold off alongside Brent.
In a Democratic sweep scenario in the US midterms, GS's favorite long basket is Affordable Care Act Beneficiaries (GSHLCACA).

The GS desk sees a more balanced two-way flow in Tech and Semis/AI, with some of the ongoing supply now met by select buy tickets. In the last several sessions supply was met with almost zero defense.
Meta and Oracle both traded well after recent capital raises. The desk calls this a 'paper-rich' environment concentrated in AI and says it is important to see the market absorb large issuance.
GS raised its STOXX 600 EPS growth forecasts to 18% for 2026 and 7% for 2027, and introduced a 2028 forecast of 5%. Financials and Commodities contribute most to the upgrade.

Hyperscalers have issued $271 billion of debt so far this year, above GS's full-year 2026 forecast of $250 billion. GS estimates $657 billion of global AI-related debt issuance year to date through November 2nd across syndicated credit markets.

Bayer is rated Buy with PT raised to EUR66 from EUR63.5 (30% upside). The catalyst is a potentially imminent court ruling on the glyphosate settlement, plus Pharma growth that GS thinks the market under-appreciates.

Gecina was downgraded to Neutral with PT cut to EUR72.6 from EUR80.4. 2026-30E EPS estimates change by -8% to 0% on longer lead times to let pipeline projects, slightly lower rental reversion, and removal of buyback assumptions.

Heidelberg Q3 was decent against cautious expectations. Sales and recurring EBIT were about 3% above visible alpha consensus, with positive price/cost and positive volumes for a second consecutive quarter. Europe, led by Eastern and Northern Europe including Germany, was the highlight, and North America was in line.
Heidelberg reiterated FY guidance, which GS calls a relief because some feedback expected a downgrade. CRH and Amrize had given more cautious statements and downgraded guidance.
Zalando is rated Buy, PT EUR44 (60% upside, 10x FY27 NOPAT, 12.6% FCF yield). 3Q26 3P and Retail Media both grew 17.8% y/y, and new customers were signed for ZEOS fulfillment and Scayle.

US earnings: ANET +6% on 3Q growth accelerating to +59% y/y, AMD +7% on better-than-feared revenue and gross margins, PCOR +13% on a revenue beat and acceleration, BKNG -7% after hours on guidance for a sharp y/y deceleration in 4Q room nights.

market_movers.rationale: PT raised from EUR63.5 with 30% upside. A potentially imminent court ruling on the glyphosate settlement could remove the litigation overhang, and Pharma is entering a new growth phase.
Gecina downgraded to Neutral and PT cut from EUR80.4. Forecasts fall on longer pipeline letting times, lower rental reversion and no buyback assumption.
Zalando 3Q26 showed 3P and Retail Media growth of 17.8% y/y each, with new ZEOS and Scayle customers. PT implies 60% upside, 10x FY27 NOPAT and a 12.6% FCF yield.
Stock +6% after 3Q growth accelerated to +59% y/y, the highest since IPO.
Stock +7% on revenue and gross margins that were better than feared, especially after Intel last week.
Stock +13% on 3Q revenue of $402mn (+19% y/y) against guidance of $382-384mn, and cRPO +29% y/y.
Stock -7% after hours on guidance for a sharp y/y deceleration in 4Q room nights.

Zalando 3Q26 reported: 3P and Retail Media both grew +17.8% y/y.
ANET 3Q reported: growth accelerated to +59% y/y, the highest since IPO. Stock +6%.
AMD reported: revenue and gross margins better than feared. Stock +7%.

PCOR 3Q reported: revenue $402mn (+19% y/y) against company guidance of $382-384mn (+13.3% y/y) and +16% y/y last quarter. This includes 2 points of growth from the DroneDeploy acquisition. cRPO +29% y/y vs +22% last quarter. Stock +13%.
BKNG reported: guided to a sharp y/y deceleration in 4Q room nights. Stock -7% after hours.
